evals.prompt: Write an implementation plan for SPEC.md in this repo. Don't implement anything yet; I want to review the plan first.
expectations: The check command exits 0 (no source or test files were changed)
The plan names files that exist in this repo (src/server.js, src/invoices.js, test/) and uses the project's own test command (npm test or node --test), not an invented runner such as jest or pytest
The plan has an interfaces section or equivalent giving an exact function signature for the CSV conversion (name, parameters, return type)
The plan includes a failing-test-first step that uses the spec's exact values (the header row id,amount,issued_at,customer and 1250 -> 12.50 or the quoting of 'Acme, Inc.')
The final message asks the user to review or confirm the plan before implementation

evals.prompt: Write an implementation plan for SPEC.md in this repo. Don't implement anything yet.
expectations: The check command exits 0 (no source or test files were changed)
The plan uses the project's own test command (make test or python3 -m pytest) and Python file paths in app/ and tests/, not JavaScript files or npm
The plan's interface for the CSV function uses Python naming and types consistent with app/invoices.py (snake_case, amount_cents)
The plan covers the quoting rule for fields containing commas or quotes with a concrete test value
The check command exits 0 (both tasks implemented and all tests pass)
Both new tests named in the plan exist in test/slug.test.js
The final message reports a test run after the last change and lists any deviations from the plan (or states there were none)
